significance: The middle shrine of the tri-ranga group of Ranganatha temples set on natural islands in the Kaveri, standing at Shivanasamudra in Chamarajanagar district. Renovation work on the remote temple began in February 2021.
story: In Sri Vaishnava belief the three island Ranganathas mark stages of the god's life, and the Shivanasamudra deity is revered as his youthful form.
